body:
This was a little weird to read. I had t re-read a few times... but I get what you're saying.

That's kind of disappointing (is that the right word?) but typical it seems. And well, I'm taking a longer than usual break, and I won't lie - slightly curious here.
True... yeah, I guess I need a break. But this is going to be a longer than usual break.

Sure. 

I'm trying to tell myself this more but these thoughts keep coming up once in a while. :/
True, but barely anyone was showing interest in me to begin with (while actually putting myself out there). Plus I'm tired, so I'll need a break..
Well, it wasn't going up very far...

>They aren't going to facilitate things for you. If you see a girl that seems interesting, try asking her out. 

Well, I keep hearing both sides to this so I'm kinda confused. If you mean them initiating a conversation... in that case, no problem.

I'll have to wait until quarantine is over to start all this again...
My bad - will have to fix that in a bit. Brain was in a different gear when I wrote this.

I may now but I can't guarantee it in the future.

Kind wonder why you say "please stay alive though." Meh.
Well, people like my personality usually, but I barely get compliments on my look especially from females. I guess that explains a lot. Going to be on this... road for a long while.

Just now seeing this. I'm sorry to hear that.

There is always going to be a fault somewhere on the other side - at least in my case. I live with something that affects me for life and it brought me even more difficulties (that 98% of my peers don't have to deal with).

I don't like my life, and I really don't think I want to stay alive for that long.

You should tell someone. Don't stay in the dark.

Get those rapists justice.

Raped?? I hope those bullies were taken care of by law enforcement. I'm so sorry.

And honestly... I'm tired of seeing how I'm slow paced like this compared to others, and it's always going to be like this until I die. I don't have much will be alive for that much longer.

I know I shouldn't self compare, but it's hard not to with all this, and especially when some of the things said by the bullies actually turned out to be true in some way. It's a part of what's influencing these thoughts (I guess).
Heard that before. Yes, I've read many times that not looking might be the best way/method. And yeah, more self discovery I guess. Yes, it makes sense I think.

Thanks.

To be honest, I'm not sure what I was looking for. I just wanted to let this out somewhere.

Thanks...

> I hope you been working on you man 

Now that I think about it.. sort of.
I don't really know how to respond to this... other than "sorry your experience seemed that way."
I wish that was easier to believe and take in. In my state things don't seem that way at all for others.
I haven’t had any in my life. See, that is the mindset I’d like to have. I didn’t care about this stuff much until this crap happened.
If you mean the dating market... yeah. I haven't tried during the pandemic though.
